Photo 1: Same as photo 0, slightly different angle. Console and controller appear identical.
Photo 2: Close-up of white controller held in hand. D-pad, analog sticks, and buttons visible. Left bumper button appears slightly cracked or damaged. Xbox logo light is illuminated blue.
All photos have watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI CENT V TECH LTD'.
No games, discs, or digital download proof shown in any photo.
No screen or power-on test shown. No indication of console being turned on or connected.
